On a quiet desk, in a quiet room, sat a book that nobody had opened in a very long time.
Inside, in a land made entirely of paper, lived a little sprite named Pip.
Pip loved Papervale. The cardboard hills. The paper sun on its wooden stick. And the river, that went swish... swish... swish.
But every evening, when the sun went down, another light came on. A big, warm light, from somewhere beyond the edge of the page.
So Pip set off, through the Whispering Woods,
where Pip learned that a grumpy crumple... just needs someone to smooth things out.
Together, they sailed the Swish Swash Sea,
on through the night, beneath the stars on their strings,
until they reached the very last page. Nothing else was drawn there. Just two words. The End.
Pip had never been off the page before. It was a little bit scary.
But the best adventures always are.
And that is how Pip found out where the big, warm light came from.
A reading lamp... and someone, reading along.
The end? Or maybe... just the beginning.
